Anna Halprin offers the wisdom of her life experience as a dancer, teacher and facilitator for healing. She tells her own story as a cancer survivor, and the stories of others, with deep compassion and clarity. This is a guide to understanding the emotional processes of a health crisis, with clear guidelines for how to work with these insights.
